territories.name: Hearthhold
territories.desc: The last fire in a fractured land. Your clan’s home, and the beginning of its story.

territories.name: Ravenwood
territories.desc: Smoke rises beyond the old bridge. Take the timber settlement and give your clan a foothold in the eastern woods.

territories.name: The Old Crossing
territories.desc: A narrow crossing held by a ragged warband. Whoever holds the bridge controls the valley.

territories.name: Briarwatch
territories.desc: Archers watch from the timber walls. Close the distance before their arrows find your line.

territories.name: Mirehollow
territories.desc: Drowned roads and low mist hide the defenders of this forsaken village.

territories.name: Alder Fields
territories.desc: The harvest lies untouched. Break the occupying warband and secure provisions for your people.

territories.name: Saltwind Keep
territories.desc: A salt-worn fortress overlooking the western sea. Towers rain arrows over the approach.

territories.name: Emberfall
territories.desc: Old furnaces still burn beneath the cliffs. Its iron will arm the next generation of your clan.

territories.name: Frostgate
territories.desc: A frozen gate at the roof of the world. Heavy infantry and tower archers hold its ancient walls.

territories.name: Wolfpine
territories.desc: Rival hunters guard the high pass. Their spears and longbows make every approach dangerous.

territories.name: Blackfen
territories.desc: The water remembers another kingdom. Armored sentries patrol what remains of its walls.

territories.name: Drowned Abbey
territories.desc: Bells no longer ring here. A hardened warband has turned the old abbey into a stronghold.

territories.name: Gull’s Rest
territories.desc: A sheltered harbor and a road to the southern coast. Wealth waits behind its palisade.

territories.name: Stormreach
territories.desc: The storm-lashed western bastion. Its defenders have never seen another banner on their walls.

territories.name: Cinder Spire
territories.desc: Beyond the black ridge, a crimson banner flies. Take the spire and break the strongest clan in the frontier.

territories.name: The Last Bastion
territories.desc: At the edge of the known world stands the final stronghold. Let your banner rise over all the frontier.

classes.name: Ironward
classes.desc: Hold the line. Balanced steel and a steadfast shield.

classes.name: Ravager
classes.desc: Break their guard with sweeping, heavy blows.

classes.name: Pikewarden
classes.desc: Keep enemies at a distance. Punish a reckless charge.

classes.name: Duskranger
classes.desc: Loose arrows from behind the line. Vulnerable up close.
